headlines.title: What You Need To Know Ahead of U.S. Bancorp’s Earnings Release
headlines.summary: U.S. Bancorp is set to report its Q3 earnings next month, with analysts expecting single-digit year-over-year EPS growth.

headlines.title: PNC vs. U.S. Bancorp: Which Regional Bank Dividend Belongs in Your Portfolio?
headlines.summary: Both PNC and U.S. Bancorp beat earnings estimates and then sold off, leaving retirees to weigh a bank with record revenues against one with an 18% dividend raise and the cleanest loan book in its peer group.

headlines.title: U.S. Bancorp (USB) Funding Deals Put Its Undervalued Narrative Back In Focus
headlines.summary: U.S. Bancorp (USB) recently completed several fixed income offerings, issuing senior unsecured callable notes maturing between 2036 and 2046 with coupons ranging from 5.75% to 6.375%. These bond deals provide equity investors with fresh information on funding terms. Against that backdrop, U.S. Bancorp’s recent fixed income activity lands at a time when the stock has eased in the short term. The 30-day share price return is down 6.

headlines.title: U.S. Bancorp (USB) Taps Calvert Lange To Lead Institutional Payments
headlines.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB) appointed Calvert Lange as Senior Vice President and Head of Payments: Merchant and Institutional Sales Group. Lange will oversee payments and treasury management coverage for technology, transportation, consumer, and hospitality sector clients. She joins U.S. Bancorp after previous senior roles at Citi and Deutsche Bank focused on institutional payments and cash management.

headlines.title: U.S. Bancorp Delivers Another Dividend Increase: Assessing the Payout
headlines.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB)’s latest dividend increase adds another step to an already long-running shareholder return program. The bank has raised its quarterly common-stock dividend by 3.8% to $0.54 per share, up from $0.52. At the new rate, shareholders will receive $2.16 per share annually, with the next payment scheduled for October 15, 2026.

description: U.S. Bancorp, a financial services holding company, provides various financial services to individuals, businesses, institutional organizations, governmental entities, and other financial institutions in the United States. The company operates through Wealth, Corporate, Commercial and Institutional Banking; Consumer and Business Banking; Payment Services; and Treasury and Corporate Support segments. It offers depository services, including checking accounts, savings accounts, and time certificate contracts; and lending services, such as traditional credit products and credit card services, lease financing and import/export trade, agricultural finance, asset-backed lending, and other products. The company also provides cash management, capital markets, and trust and investment management services; and ancillary services comprising capital markets, treasury management, and receivable lock-box collection services to corporate and governmental entity customers. In addition, it offers asset management and fiduciary services for individuals, estates, foundations, business corporations, and charitable organizations; and investment and insurance products to its customers principally within its domestic markets, as well as fund administration services to mutual and other funds. Further, the company provides corporate and purchasing card, and corporate trust services; and credit card services, merchant and ATM processing, mortgage banking, insurance, brokerage and leasing services. U.S. Bancorp was founded in 1863 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.
